# Document Set — what exists, where, and what changes together

A complete project documentation set (all paths relative to the project's docs root; the project card may move the
root). Create only the documents the work touches. Templates are in `templates/`; every template is placeholders only.

```
{docs-root}/
├── Plan.md                                  plan-master.md
├── PLAN_{SERVICE}.md                        plan-service.md (also the feature-plan variant)
├── UI_SPEC.md                               ui-design-system.md            (optional)
├── Workflow/{Process}.md                    workflow.md
├── docs/business/{NN}_{MODULE}.md           business-module.md             (optional)
├── docs/contracts/{topic}.md                message-contract.md
├── DB/
│   ├── Data Dictionary/DATA_DICT.md + {NN}_{Module}.md     data-dictionary.md
│   └── ER Diagrams/ER_DIAGRAMS.md + {NN}_{Module}.md       er-diagram.md
├── Deployments/
│   ├── {service}/PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT.md   release/production-readiness.md
│   └── {service}/v{X.Y.Z}/                  release/release.md, manifest.md, checklist.md,
│                                             rollback-plan.md, test-result.md, security-review.md
└── app/
    ├── {http-api}/                          (per-endpoint HTTP service)
    │   ├── API-ENDPOINTS.md                 api-endpoints.md
    │   ├── USER-MATRIX.md                   user-matrix.md
    │   ├── api-spec/{group}/{METHOD}-{NAME}.md        backend-standard.md
    │   ├── api-spec/{group}/SCHEMA.md                 table-schema.md
    │   └── api-flow-chart/{group}/{METHOD}-{NAME}.md  backend-standard.md
    ├── {small-http-service}/                (few endpoints, external API, webhook receiver)
    │   ├── api-spec/{SERVICE}.md            program-spec.md
    │   └── api-flow-chart/{METHOD}-{NAME}.md
    ├── {worker-service}/                    (consumer / producer / poller / scheduler)
    │   ├── {service}-spec/{service}-spec.md            service-spec.md
    │   └── {service}-flowchart/{service}-flowchart.md  service-flowchart.md
    └── {web-app}/
        ├── SWC-Overview.md                  swc-overview.md
        ├── Testing-Overview.md              testing-overview.md
        ├── SWC/{module}/shared.md, page-{page}-{spec|diagram|wireframe}.md,
        │   {component}-{spec|diagram}.md     frontend-standard.md
        └── Testing/{module}-{page}-testing.md          page-testing.md
```

Module numbers `{NN}` are shared by the business module, data dictionary and ER files. Prefer ISO dates
(YYYY-MM-DD) everywhere. File names are spelled exactly as above (upper-case `PLAN_`, `API-ENDPOINTS`), because
links are case-sensitive on most servers.

## Update together (same task, same commit)

| When this changes | Also update |
|---|---|
| An endpoint (new / changed / removed) | its api-spec + api-flow-chart, the row in API-ENDPOINTS.md, the row in USER-MATRIX.md |
| A page or component | its spec, diagram, wireframe headers (Last Updated), the SWC-Overview row |
| Tests of a page | `Testing/{module}-{page}-testing.md`, then the Testing-Overview row |
| A worker's behaviour | service-spec and service-flowchart (same version and date); the message contract if the payload changed |
| A table or column | migration + table-schema (if the feature has one), then regenerate data dictionary + ER + both indexes |
| A business process | the one Workflow file; pages and endpoints only link to it |
| A release | a new `Deployments/{service}/v{X.Y.Z}/` folder; plans copy status, they do not track it twice |

## Rules learned from real document sets

- Links are relative. Never an absolute path, and never a path from another person's machine.
- One source per fact: no second copy of a workflow, schema or screen flow in another format; superseded files move
  to `_deprecated_v{n}/` or carry "Superseded by ..." at the top.
- Tracker cells stay short (status icon + a few words). Narrative, counts and lessons go in the linked document.
- History goes in a Change Log section, not in stacked "Previous:" header lines or a long "Last Updated" sentence.
- Plans hold tasks; specs hold what was built; Deployments hold what shipped. Do not mix the three in one file.
- Counts, dates and "passed" only from a real run; otherwise ❌ / 📋 and the reason.
- Diagrams in Mermaid where the renderer supports it; ASCII only for wireframes and screen layouts.

## Headers

Every document has at least **Last Updated** (or Version + Date for versioned types: plans, worker/program specs,
data dictionary, ER, releases). When the project tracks requirements (its project card says so, or REQ/AC ids
already exist), SWC spec files also carry **Status**, **Evidence** (Current / Proposed / POC / Verified), **REQ Refs**
and **Owner** as described in `swc-central.md`.
